camera_rendering: sensor_configs and render backend during replay
control_mode_conversion: official tool supports selected conversions on CPU, but Phase 2B.5 did not convert the accepted direct pd_joint_pos sources
gpu_cpu_limitations: CPU/GPU reset physics may differ; official --use-first-env-state anchors the stored initial state. Control-mode conversion is unavailable in parallel GPU replay.
metadata_format: JSON env_info plus per-episode reset/control/success records
observation_conversion: --obs-mode can generate RGB while replaying actions or stored states
source_type_metadata: archive directory identity such as motionplanning/rl/teleop
trajectory_format: HDF5 traj_<episode_id> groups with actions, T transition arrays, and T+1 recursive env_states
